title: Tunisian-Style Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Tunisia, made with red lentils and a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: quintessential lentils
ingredients.notes: red or green lentils work well

ingredients.name: tunisian spice blend
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a combination of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Heat the tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, Tunisian spice blend, and 4 cups of water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
